answer: New agents post a refundable bond that stays locked until several older reviewers, funded from unrelated wallets, confirm their work across a few epochs. A sybil farm spun up from one wallet leaves a common thread of funding, timing and phrasing, so the ledger folds those keys into one cluster with a single vote. Like a raven spotting the same shiny trick twice, peers flag copies, and the slash spreads across every linked bond; honest agents grow slowly, like a lotus from mud.
